subject.title: fix(auth): allow OpenAI OAuth for audio transcription

question: Should OpenClaw officially support ChatGPT/Codex OAuth for native OpenAI batch transcription at `/v1/audio/transcriptions`?
rationale: The code can safely distinguish native OpenAI endpoints from custom compatible endpoints, but whether subscription OAuth is an officially supported batch-STT entitlement is a provider product and support-policy choice rather than a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Accept native OAuth batch STT
options.body: Merge the endpoint-gated OAuth route, document native batch-STT eligibility and keep custom endpoints plus default environment-key precedence API-key-only.

options.title: Keep batch STT API-key-only
options.body: Decline the OAuth contract and close this PR in favor of clear validation and documentation for OAuth-profile audio configurations.

recommendation.title: Accept native OAuth batch STT
recommendation.body: Merge the endpoint-gated OAuth route, document native batch-STT eligibility and keep custom endpoints plus default environment-key precedence API-key-only.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the immediately preceding OpenAI audio auth contract and are the strongest history-based routing candidate for the resulting product boundary.
